lifestyle.label: Lifestyle
lifestyle.recommendation: Prioritize the downstream CPA event: a healthy campaign should convert more than 70% of installs toward the defined CPA action.

music.label: Music
music.recommendation: Use subscription starts as the primary quality signal and aim to keep install-to-subscription conversion above 40%.

productivity.label: Productivity
productivity.recommendation: Optimize toward subscription starts rather than installs alone; the benchmark quality threshold is above 40%.

shopping.label: Shopping / E-commerce
shopping.recommendation: Treat first purchase as the core optimization event and target an install-to-purchase rate above 50%.

games-casual-puzzle.label: Games — Casual Puzzle
games-casual-puzzle.recommendation: For iOS US, keep CPI within $2–4 while protecting early ROAS signals: above 5% on D1 and 25–30% or higher on D7.

travel.label: Travel / Booking
travel.recommendation: Balance scale with two quality gates: over 40% reaching search or registration and at least 8–12% completing a booking.

games-action-strategy.label: Games — Action / Strategy
games-action-strategy.recommendation: For this IAP-led model, allow a higher $4–6 CPI only when cohort quality supports D30 ROAS above 100%.

games-idle.label: Games — Idle
games-idle.recommendation: For iOS US, keep CPI below $4 and use D0 ROAS above 30% as an early signal toward D30 payback above 100%.

games-puzzle-iaa.label: Games — Puzzle
games-puzzle-iaa.recommendation: For this IAA-led model on iOS US, target $2–4 CPI while maintaining D1 ROAS above 5% and D7 ROAS above 30%.

finance.label: Finance
finance.recommendation: Assess traffic quality beyond registration: more than 70% should register and 30–50% of registrants should transfer money.

sports-betting.label: Sports / Betting
sports-betting.recommendation: Optimize toward first-time deposit quality, targeting more than 20% install-to-FTD while holding CPI within $4–6.

rewards.label: Rewards App
rewards.recommendation: Use completed registration as the first quality checkpoint and target a 70% conversion rate from install.

utility.label: Utility
utility.recommendation: Track both stages of the trial funnel: 40% of installs starting a trial and 20–25% of trials converting.

utility-vpn.label: Utility — VPN
utility-vpn.recommendation: Prioritize retained users over raw volume and keep D1 retention above 30% as the main early quality signal.
